# recsim.user

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_api_docs.py; do not edit. -->

Abstract classes that encode a user's state and dynamics.

This version has been updated to use gymnasium instead of gym,
and to rely on Python 3's abc.ABC instead of six.add_metaclass.

## Public symbols

- `AbstractResponse()`
- `AbstractUserModel(response_model_ctor, user_sampler, slate_size)`
- `AbstractUserSampler(user_ctor, seed=0)`
- `AbstractUserState()`
